name: Play from the editor loads the level being edited
body:
Dean (2026-11-06, Mac): with the game launching from Play, it fails with "OnRender: no entity with id 0". The log shows the real failure first: "Not found: assets/assets/worlds/.editor-play.world.json".

Cause: the Nox editor host names its assets directory relative to the repository root ("assets"), so Play set LANTERN_LEVEL to "assets/worlds/.editor-play.world.json". The game resolves a relative level path against its assets directory, which is also "assets", so it looked in assets/assets/. The level never loaded, the player never spawned, and OnRender then asked for entity 0. The C++ host passed an absolute assets directory, which hid this.

Fix: Play sets LANTERN_LEVEL to the level's path inside the assets directory ("worlds/.editor-play.world.json"), which the game resolves against LANTERN_ASSETS whether that is relative or absolute.
